add_to_live_meeting.description: Send the Fireflies.ai notetaker into a meeting that is happening now, so it records and transcribes the call. Works with Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams links. Fireflies allows 3 of these requests every 20 minutes.
add_to_live_meeting.name: add_to_live_meeting

parameters.description: The https link to the live meeting to join, for example a Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams URL.
parameters.name: meeting_link

parameters.description: The title to file the recording under in Fireflies. Leave blank to use the meeting's own name.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: The password or passcode the meeting needs, if it has one.
parameters.name: meeting_password

parameters.description: How many minutes the notetaker should stay in the meeting. Leave blank to let Fireflies decide.
parameters.name: duration

parameters.description: The language spoken in the meeting, as a code such as 'en' or 'es'. Leave blank to use your Fireflies default.
parameters.name: language

success.description: Whether the notetaker was sent to the meeting.

get_meeting_summary.name: get_meeting_summary

parameters.description: The ID of the meeting to summarize. You can get this from the List meetings action.
parameters.name: meeting_id

action_items.description: The follow-up tasks identified in the meeting, one per line.

date.description: When the meeting took place, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

keywords.description: The main topics and terms from the meeting.

outline.description: A section-by-section outline of the meeting.

summary.description: A written overview of what the meeting covered.

get_transcript.description: Get the full word-for-word transcript of one meeting, as a single speaker-labelled text block and as individual timestamped lines. Use the List meetings action first to find the meeting's ID.

sentences.text: Let's start with the release timeline.

get_transcript.name: get_transcript

parameters.description: The ID of the meeting to transcribe. You can get this from the List meetings action.
parameters.name: meeting_id

date.description: When the meeting took place, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

duration.description: How long the meeting lasted, in minutes.

host_email.description: Email address of the meeting host.

participants.description: Email addresses of everyone who took part.

sentence_count.description: How many transcript lines the meeting has.

end_time.description: When the line ends, in seconds from the beginning of the meeting.

start_time.description: When the line starts, in seconds from the beginning of the meeting.

speakers.description: The names of everyone who spoke.

text.description: The whole transcript as text, one 'Speaker: what they said' line per sentence.

transcript_url.description: Link to the meeting in Fireflies.ai.

list_meetings.description: List the meetings Fireflies.ai has recorded and transcribed, newest first. Optionally narrow the results to a date range, a host, or a participant. Use this to find a meeting's ID before getting its summary or transcript.
list_meetings.name: list_meetings

parameters.description: Only include meetings held on or after this date and time, for example 2026-07-15T09:00:00Z. Leave blank to include meetings from any start date.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Only include meetings held on or before this date and time, for example 2026-07-31T17:00:00Z. Leave blank to include meetings up to the present.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: The most meetings to return, from 1 to 50. Leave blank to use the Fireflies default.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only include meetings hosted by this email address. Leave blank to include meetings from any host.
parameters.name: host_email

parameters.description: Only include meetings this email address attended. Leave blank to include meetings with any participant.
parameters.name: participant_email

meetings.description: The meetings that matched, newest first.

date.description: When the meeting took place, as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

duration.description: How long the meeting lasted, in minutes.

host_email.description: Email address of the meeting host.

id.description: The meeting's unique ID. Use this with the summary and transcript actions.

participants.description: Email addresses of everyone who took part.

transcript_url.description: Link to the meeting in Fireflies.ai.

list_users.description: List the people in your Fireflies.ai workspace, with how many meetings each has recorded. Use this to find the email address to filter meetings by.
list_users.name: list_users

is_admin.description: Whether the member administers the workspace.

minutes_consumed.description: How many transcription minutes the member has used.

num_transcripts.description: How many meetings the member has recorded.

upload_audio.description: Send an audio or video recording to Fireflies.ai to be transcribed. The file is fetched from a public URL and transcribed in the background, so its notes appear in the List meetings action a few minutes later. Needs a paid Fireflies plan: on the free plan this action returns 'You need to be subscribed to a paid plan to perform this action', though the rest of the integration still works. Fireflies also rejects files smaller than 50KB.
upload_audio.display_str_template: Send a recording to Fireflies for transcription.
upload_audio.name: upload_audio

parameters.description: A publicly reachable https link to the audio or video file to transcribe, for example an mp3, mp4, or wav.
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: The title to file the recording under in Fireflies. Leave blank to use the file name.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Who took part in the recording. Each attendee needs an email; name and phone_number are optional.
parameters.name: attendees

message.description: What Fireflies reported about the upload.

title.description: The title the recording was filed under.

description: Bring your Fireflies.ai meeting recordings and AI notes into your workflows.
